allowed_conclusion: If SUPPORTED: on that panel only, the LP guidance contributes at least the minimum useful effect (ablation). Not a statement about other components, families or domains.

baselines.comparator: the registered ablation of the frozen candidate (replay_contracts.INTERVENTIONS)
baselines.meaning: ablation: no LP guidance (random-order greedy restarts for the same stage budget); placebo: the same LP solve and restarts with the LP values permuted among the edges

capability_changes: None: a causal follow-up of the E1b claim; the arms differ in one registered component.
exact_claim: The frozen construction-pipeline candidate (descriptor f5a3d7ffd69c014e) scores more edges than the same candidate after removing its LP guidance (the registered ablation: init random_greedy, the same budget) (descriptor c1a3928eb9142cdb), on a custodian-held CONFIRM panel of triangle_free_host_v1 hosts drawn from the e1b study calibration (rule e1-hard-v2, record SHA-256 bc26782a0c5916e9, settings planted_cluster {'n': 30, 'p_in': 0.6, 'p_out': 0.2}, erdos {'n': 26, 'p': 0.35}, erdos {'n': 30, 'p': 0.3}), by at least the minimum useful effect, under the registered analysis.
exposure_policy: Custodian-built exposure registry; every host the builder named or generated; a CONFIRM panel is retired after its one use.
permissible_information: The candidate sees only the candidate view (domain, n, edges). Development used public DEV panels only. SELECT and CONFIRM are drawn and held by the custodian.
raw_evidence_custody: Custodian private evidence store; the judge recomputes the analysis; the custodian publishes a signed registration log.
rejection_criteria: Any decision-record or plan check failing; an evaluator that cannot run the candidate; registration beyond the declared family size; an INVALID or NOT_SUPPORTED outcome. An intervened arm that is not the registered intervention of the frozen candidate.

sample_size_justification.model: headroom-limited integer improvements over centred DEV pilot differences
sample_size_justification.note: pilot effect sizes are reported but never used to set the effect; only spread and headroom are

total_budget.charge: every attempt, retry, timeout and failure
total_budget.equal_accounting: one sandbox, one profile, cgroup CPU per arm
